subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw officially own qwen-token-plan and the runtime-only bailian-token-plan custom-provider boundary in the qwen plugin?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and has accepted real-behavior proof, but it creates new official provider/auth/env/catalog contracts for a third-party subscription plan, which is a product ownership decision rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Accept bundled Qwen Token Plan
options.body: Land the provider after a fresh merge-result check confirms the generated catalogs, docs, endpoint classification, config validation, and custom-provider boundary remain aligned.

options.title: Narrow Bailian first
options.body: Keep the canonical qwen-token-plan provider but remove or further document the bailian-token-plan runtime-only owner before merge.

options.title: Route outside bundled qwen
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want Token Plan support to ship as an external plugin, ClawHub package, or custom-provider documentation instead of an official qwen plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Qwen Token Plan
recommendation.body: Land the provider after a fresh merge-result check confirms the generated catalogs, docs, endpoint classification, config validation, and custom-provider boundary remain aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch commits, assignment, and qwen provider history make steipete the clearest owner for the product-acceptance call.
